youtube_title: Itchy After A Hot Shower? The Water Is The Problem | Body Fix #17 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #17. Boiling hot bath in winter... and you're ITCHING the moment you step out?
B is right. LUKEWARM water, and moisturise right after.
Very hot water strips your skin's natural oils. Dry air does the rest.
Fix: 5-10 min lukewarm shower, cream within 3 MIN, mild soap, no hard scrub.
Red flags: Cracked bleeding skin, itch waking you up, spreading rash? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: AAD - Dry skin in winter
